name: shopping-agent
description: Search ten Shopify APIs with exact/similar matching, then use Chrome only after complete zero-result coverage.

interface.shortDescription: Match products across ten Shopify stores.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap-Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.2.1 searches ten fixed Shopify Storefront pilots once, ranks exact identity and variant matches before labeled similar products, excludes irrelevant products, asks for missing details, and uses authorized Chrome only after complete API coverage returns zero products.
defaultPrompt: Use FindCheap-Agent to search ten Shopify stores once, return exact matches before labeled similar products, ask for missing model or variant details, and use authorized Chrome only after complete zero-result coverage.
